name: Banh A Choi
summary: Bánh A Chôi is a Bru–Vân Kiều dish, part of the village table with bánh A Dưh, Láp, and rượu cần at community rites and festivals.
origin: Bru–Vân Kiều villages in the Phong Nha-Ke Bang buffer.
culture: These dishes are tied to community life, rites, and festivals in the heritage area.
howToEat: Ask in the Bru–Vân Kiều villages, especially around a festival.
where: Bru–Vân Kiều villages in the buffer.
seoTitle: Banh A Choi — a Bru-Van Kieu cake
seoDescription: Bánh A Chôi is a Bru–Vân Kiều dish of the villages near Phong Nha, eaten with bánh A Dưh, Láp, and rượu cần at rites and festivals.
